about: Golden cases for the so-what composer. Inputs: spec/sowhat-fixtures/<n>.json (engine responses, rules_v2, captured 2026-10-06) plus the two classifier answers measured on Winnow-12B during design (story.frame, story.trigger). Expected output: headline, line2, template, lead, and each beat with its trace. Old = what the current page prints for the same input.
